senses.gloss:
अप् + -चरः, -सरः an aquatic animal. त्रीण्याद्यान्याश्रितास्त्वेषां मृगगर्ताश्रयाऽप्सराः
 Ms. 7. 72. See अप्सरः. {@-पतिः@}
—1 ‘Lord of waters’, N. of Varuṇa.
—2 the ocean.
अप्सरः [अप्-सृ-अच्] Any aquatic animal (moving in water).

अप्सः, -प्सा m. ▪.(-प्साः Ved.)
 [अपःसनोति, सन्-ड]
—1 Giving or yielding water; forming the essential portion of water (अपां
 सारभूतो रसः).
—2 not destroying.

अप्सः, -प्सा m. ▪.(-प्साः Ved.)
 [अपःसनोति, सन्-ड]
—1 Giving or yielding water; forming the essential portion of water (अपां
 सारभूतो रसः).
—2 not destroying.
अप्सः, -प्सा m. ▪.(-प्साः Ved.) + .{@-प्सम्@} Form, see अप्सस्.

अप्सरस् f. (-राः, -रा)
 [अदूभ्यः सरन्ति उद्गच्छन्ति, सृ-असुन् Uṇ. 4. 236;
 cf. Rām. अप्सु निर्मथनादेव रसात्तस्माद्वरस्त्रियः । उत्पेतुर्मनुजश्रेष्ठ
 तस्मादप्सरसोऽभवन् ॥]
—1 A class of female divinities or celestial damsels who reside in the
 sky and are regarded as the wives of the Gandharvas. They are very fond
 of bathing, can change their shapes, and are endowed with superhuman power
 (प्रभाव).
[]
 They are called स्वर्वेश्याः and are usually described as the servants
 of Indra, who, when alarmed by the rigorous austerities of some mighty
 sage, sends down one of them to disturb his penance, and her mission is
 generally successful; मेनकाऽप्सरसां श्रेष्ठा महर्षीणां पिता च ते
 Mb. 1. 74. 75. cf. या तपोविशेषपरिशाङ्कितस्य सुकुमारं प्रहरणं
 महेन्द्रस्य V. 1. They are also said to covet heroes who die gloriously
 on the battle-field; cf. परस्परेण क्षतयोः प्रहर्त्रेरुत्कान्तवाथ्वोः
 समकालमेव । अमर्त्यभावेऽपि कयोश्चिदासीदेकाप्सरः प्रार्थितयोर्विवादः ॥
 R. 7. 53. Bāṇa mentions 14 different families of these nymphs (see
 K. 136) The word is usually said to be in pl. (स्त्रियां बहुष्वप्सरसः)
 but the singular, as also the form अप्सरा, sometimes occurs; नियमविघ्नकारिणी
 मेनका नाम अप्सराः प्रेषिता Ś. 1; एकाप्सरः &c. R. 7. 53 and see
 Malli. thereon; अनप्सरेव प्रतिभासि V. 1.
—2 Direction or the intermediate point of the compass (दिक् च उपदिक् च).
.━{@Comp.@}: अप्सरस्तीर्थम्, अप्सरःपतिः

अप्सरस् + -तीर्थम् N. of a sacred pool in which the Apsarasas bathe; probably
 it is the name of a place, see Ś. 6.

अप्सरस् + -पतिः lord of the Apsarasas, epithet of Indra. N. of the Gandharva
 शिखण्डिन्; Av. 4. 37. 7.
अप्सव्य a. [अप्सु भवः यत्] Being in, or fit for, water.

अप्सस् n. Ved. Form, beauty; or one possessed of beauty; cheek (?).
 उषा हस्रेव नि रिणीते अप्सः Rv. 1. 124. 7^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251204. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/101.

अप्सु a. [नास्ति प्सु रूपं यस्य Nir.]
—1 Formless, shapeless.
—2 Not beautiful. Note:− -अप्सु forms the first member of several compounds.

अप्सु + .{@-क्षित्@} a god (dwelling within the clouds); अप्सुक्षितो महिनैकादश
 स्थ Rv. 1. 139. 11.
अप्सु + .{@-चर@} a. aquatic; moving in waters. P. VI. 3. 1.

अप्सु + .{@-ज, -जा@} a. born in the waters or in the atmosphere; यदग्ने
 दिविजा अस्यप्सुजा वा सहस्कृत Rv. 8. 43. 28.

अप्सु + .{@-ज, -जा@} a. born in the waters or in the atmosphere; यदग्ने
 दिविजा अस्यप्सुजा वा सहस्कृत Rv. 8. 43. 28.
अप्सु + .{@-जित्@} vanquishing the aerial Asuras.

अप्सु + .{@-मत्@} a. possessed of what is in water; not losing oneʼs nature
 in water (as lightning); getting sufficient water.
अप्सु + .{@-योनि@} a. born from the waters.
